holderQuote: This is my gift. Three times per day I may use [Benediction of Hope] to ease those in need.
effectQuote: to ease those in need. I think it calms the thoughts. It gives our people hope, a small blessing.

holderQuote: In the weeks since he had gained his [Benediction of Hope] Skill, Pawn’s congregation had grown.
But still. Pawn walked along the room. He put his hands on Workers and Soldiers’ shoulders. And he murmured.
effectQuote: Three times, he whispered the Skill. Three times, a group of Antinium straightened. And they relaxed. They gazed up. And they raised their mandibles. Smiling. Hope shone in them. It was all Pawn could do.

holderQuote: Heaven. Something worth dying for. And more—worth living for. Pawn’s hands were gentle as he blessed the first Worker. His [Benediction of Hope] made the Antinium rise. But more than that, the [Priest] prayed, and the Antinium prayed with him. For the dead.
effectQuote: Heaven. Something worth dying for. And more—worth living for. Pawn’s hands were gentle as he blessed the first Worker. His [Benediction of Hope] made the Antinium rise. But more than that, the [Priest] prayed, and the Antinium prayed with him. For the dead.

holderQuote: Mrsha looked up at Pawn, and the [Priest] nodded to her. She stuck out a paw, tentatively, a question in her eyes, and he touched her.
effectQuote: Mrsha sighed, and then smiled and went to sleep.

holderQuote: Until it wore off. Oh, Mrsha remembered, but the [Benediction of Hope] was still temporary. It…might have worked better on Rufelt and Numbtongue, frankly. Maybe Pawn had been stingy, because the Gnoll certainly seemed more alive.
I could get Pawn to cast [Benediction of Hope]
I have prayed for him, but my [Benediction of Hope] did not work.
